## Silvaco at DAC 2026


# Join Silvaco at DAC 2026


#### July 26 – July 29, 2026
Long Beach Convention Center | Booth 1155


Join us at DAC where innovation in semiconductor design comes to life. Stop by our booth to explore how we are advancing AI-driven design, modeling, and IP solutions.


# **Featured Technologies**


**Utmost — AI-Driven SPICE Model Extraction & Characterization** Generate accurate, design-ready compact models in a fraction of the time.
Utmost transforms process and device data into SPICE models your simulations can trust—ensuring alignment between simulation and silicon while reducing manual tuning, model uncertainty, and costly respins.


**Jivaro / Viso — AI-Driven Parasitic & Analog Analysis** Eliminate post-layout surprises in analog and mixed-signal design.
Jivaro and Viso apply machine learning to parasitic extraction and analysis, helping identify yield-impacting effects early and closing the gap between pre- and post-layout simulation.


**CellForge — Standard Cell Library Automation** From transistor netlist to DRC-clean layout — faster.
CellForge 3D automates standard cell layout generation for advanced-nodes, helping teams reduce manual effort and focus on design optimization.


**Silvaco Memory IP** Accelerate time-to-market with silicon-proven memory solutions.
Silvaco PRO Memory IP delivers SP-SRAM, DP-SRAM, register files, and ROM across nodes from 130nm to 22nm—enabling rapid integration and meeting the accelerated product cycles driven by AI innovation.


**Mixel MIPI IP** Power high-performance data interfaces for AI-driven systems.
Silvaco’s Mixel MIPI IP portfolio is silicon-proven across 9 foundries and 12 process nodes (180nm to 5nm), enabling efficient sensor-to-system data transfer for applications including automotive, wearable, and robotics.


**IPGrid (IPAudit/IPVault)** Track all your IP in a centralized location and improve traceability and reuse across teams, sites, and programs.


# Featured Speaking Session


Join Silvaco CEO Wally Rhines at Cooley’s DAC Troublemaker Panel—a candid, open Q&A addressing the most pressing and controversial topics in EDA today.


[View Session Details](https://63dac.conference-program.com/presentation/?id=PAV105&sess=sess217)
